content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"no","applies_why":"No, because the judge text treats the relevant material as answered on both sides and does not count any cited verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.","room":"The key phrase is 'A verse the judge says was answered is not counted' read against 'counts as an unanswered witness': reading one, the rule is triggered only by an unanswered-witness count, and this text only says material was answered; reading two, any mention of a cited verse in an answer ruling would require the quote-and-name procedure, but the rule expressly excludes answered verses from counting.","why":"The judge expressly says the relevant wording and application were answered in named rounds, and the rule says a verse the judge says was answered is not counted."}
